mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment, electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), and increased risk of acute kidney injury when used concurrently.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium) frequently; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antiviral if possible; adjust dosing based on renal function changes.
